title: Referee loops and session coordination
summary: Proposed session state is separate from world truth. Ten minutes is a usability budget, not ten world minutes. Timers, silence and disconnects never imply an action, consent or world-clock advancement. Narrative, UI and voice implementation remain deferred behind headless gates.

sources.title: D&D SRD 5.2.1
sources.locator: Printed pp.5–6 Rhythm of Play / Ability Checks; pp.186–187 Passive Perception / Search

sources.title: Cairn SRD
sources.locator: Principles for Wardens: Information, Difficulty, Danger, Choice; Teamwork

sources.title: Blades Action Roll

claims.statement: D&D describes situation, character declarations and adjudicated results, with opportunities for each character outside combat. This supports tracking invitations, not a particular queue algorithm.

Cairn emphasizes useful information, understandable danger and clarification. Blades separates the intended goal from a fictional method and risk/effect judgments. These are ruleset-specific practices, not universal rules.
SRD 5.2.1 distinguishes passive awareness from the Search action. Do not infer a universal passive floor for every active check or give the narrator authority to reveal hidden information.

proposals.title: Explicit referee/session state machine

fields.name: session_revision
fields.meaning: CAS for transport coordination, never ledger head

fields.name: phase
fields.type: enum FRAME COLLECT CLARIFY ADJUDICATE SUBMIT PRESENT ROTATE PAUSED ESCALATED REFRAME

fields.name: response_status_by_actor
fields.meaning: Missing response does not fabricate a pass

fields.name: confirmed_intent_hash
fields.meaning: Invalidate confirmation if material stakes change

rules: FRAME -> COLLECT -> CLARIFY -> ADJUDICATE -> SUBMIT -> PRESENT -> ROTATE; complete intents may skip CLARIFY. Missing rules go to ESCALATED. Stale heads go to REFRAME.
Pinned rule/exception -> supported campaign ruling -> designated operator adjudication. Unsupported mechanics remain paused; the model cannot invent an authority rule.
Solo budget proposal: first minute frame, minutes1–3 clarify, minutes3–8 resolve supported actions, final2minutes checkpoint. Validate this schedule with users.
Party windows invite each participant before another ordinary invitation to the same participant; preserve actual ruleset initiative. Deliver private cues separately.
World state changes only through supported TELOS proposals; epistemic acquisition requires its authorized commit path.

benchmarks.title: Private passive cue
benchmarks.given: A alone satisfies a pinned perception rule and sensory condition.
benchmarks.when: The perception procedure grants an observation.
then: Only A acquires the claim after the authorized commit.
B and the party view remain unchanged.
benchmarks.oracle: Compare authorized claim-ID sets; this ruleset procedure is future work.

benchmarks.title: Deadline is not an action
benchmarks.given: A has submitted; B,C,D await invitations.
benchmarks.when: A submits again and the soft session timer expires.
then: No automatic pass, consent, proposal or world-time advance.
benchmarks.oracle: Session transition table plus unchanged ledger head/time.

benchmarks.title: Stale confirmation and retry
benchmarks.when: First commits, second submits against H, first retries unchanged.
then: First retry returns original outcome and adds no event.
Future session reframe invalidates confirmation when stakes change.
benchmarks.oracle: Existing authority/CAS test patterns plus proposed session state test.

open_questions: What invitation policy works for mixed text/voice and accessibility needs? No usability study is claimed.
Perception mechanics require the selected versioned ruleset; current Tempted Fates has no general Search action.
